accordion.description: Reveal related sections without leaving the page.
accordion.guidance: Compose one AccordionItem per section with a stable value. Use defaultValue for an initially open section.

alert.description: Keep an important status message visible within the page.
alert.guidance: Pair a short title with actionable supporting text. Use an alert dialog when the user must make a decision.

alert-dialog.description: Ask for confirmation before an important action.
alert-dialog.guidance: Give the dialog a title and description. Keep a clear cancel action next to the confirmation button.

aspect-ratio.description: Reserve a predictable shape for images, video, or other media.
aspect-ratio.guidance: Set ratio to width divided by height. Size the parent container to control the final dimensions.

attachment.description: Present a file with its name, details, and optional actions.
attachment.guidance: Compose media, content, and actions to suit your file type. Download and upload behavior stays in your application.

avatar.description: Identify a person or team with an image and fallback initials.
avatar.guidance: Provide meaningful alternative text for images. AvatarFallback remains useful while an image loads or fails.

badge.description: Label an item with a compact status or category.
badge.guidance: Choose a variant that matches the meaning. Keep labels short and do not rely on color alone.

breadcrumb.description: Show the hierarchy leading to the current page.
breadcrumb.guidance: Link earlier locations and mark the final item as the current page. Keep this hierarchy separate from primary navigation.

bubble.description: Group a short conversational message into a visual bubble.
bubble.guidance: Use align to distinguish speakers. BubbleContent can render a link or button when the bubble itself is interactive.

button.description: Trigger an action or give a link the appearance of a button.
button.guidance: Use variant and size to express hierarchy. Set type explicitly inside forms and label icon-only buttons.

button-group.description: Arrange related actions as a single visual group.
button-group.guidance: Group actions that affect the same content. Each child remains a regular button with its own accessible label.

calendar.description: Choose a date or explore a month using a calendar grid.
calendar.guidance: Set mode to single, multiple, or range. Connect selected and onSelect when the application controls the selection.

card.description: Organize related content and actions into a contained surface.
card.guidance: Use the header for a title and supporting context. Place the primary action in the footer when it follows the content.

carousel.description: Move through a sequence of slides in a limited space.
carousel.guidance: Place slides inside CarouselContent. Keep previous and next controls reachable and give images descriptive alternative text.

chart.description: Render data visualizations with shared theme colors and tooltips.
chart.guidance: Provide a ChartContainer config for each series. Give the chart a measurable height and pass your data to the Recharts chart.

checkbox.description: Toggle an independent choice or select several options.
checkbox.guidance: Always associate the checkbox with visible text. Use checked and onCheckedChange for a controlled field.

collapsible.description: Reveal an optional region of content on demand.
collapsible.guidance: Keep the trigger visible when the content is closed. Use Accordion when you need a collection of related sections.

combobox.description: Search a list of choices and select a matching value.
combobox.guidance: Pass items to the root and render options in ComboboxList. Include an empty state for searches without results.

command.description: Filter and execute actions from a keyboard-friendly list.
command.guidance: Organize related commands into groups. Handle onSelect on an item to connect it to a real application action.

context-menu.description: Show contextual actions for a right-clicked element.
context-menu.guidance: Attach the trigger to the target content. Provide another way to reach essential actions on touch devices.

data-table.description: Render typed records using a reusable TanStack Table v9 composition.
data-table.guidance: Define columns with createColumnHelper and pass records as data. This minimal composition can be extended with table features such as sorting and pagination.

date-picker.description: Choose a date from a calendar inside a popover.
date-picker.guidance: Control the selection with value and onValueChange. Use disabled to prevent changes and locale to localize the calendar.

dialog.description: Focus attention on a task in a modal window.
dialog.guidance: Include a title and description for context. Use render to compose the trigger with a Button, and close the dialog after completing the task.

direction.description: Provide text direction to components that support right-to-left layouts.
direction.guidance: Wrap the relevant subtree in DirectionProvider. Set the HTML dir attribute as well when surrounding text and layout should follow the same direction.

drawer.description: Present supporting content in a panel that enters from an edge.
drawer.guidance: Give the panel a title and a clear dismissal action. Keep long content scrollable and place primary actions where they remain reachable.

dropdown-menu.description: Offer a compact list of actions from a trigger.
dropdown-menu.guidance: Use menu items for commands rather than form fields. Group related actions and make disabled options visibly unavailable.

empty.description: Explain why a collection has no content and offer a next step.
empty.guidance: Use a specific title and useful description. Add an action when the user can create or recover the missing content.

field.description: Lay out a label, control, description, and validation feedback.
field.guidance: Connect the label to the control with htmlFor and id. Field supplies layout; your form library supplies validation and state.

form.description: Connect React Hook Form state with accessible labels and validation messages.
form.guidance: Wrap controls in FormField and FormItem. Compose FormControl with render, and pass validation rules to FormField.

hover-card.description: Reveal supporting information when a trigger is hovered or focused.
hover-card.guidance: Use it for optional context rather than essential instructions. Keep the trigger useful as a link even without opening the card.

input.description: Collect a single line of text using a styled input.
input.guidance: Choose an appropriate HTML type and supply a label. Use value and onChange when managing the field in application state.

input-group.description: Attach labels, icons, or actions to a text control.
input-group.guidance: Place the editable input inside InputGroup. Use addons for context without replacing a proper field label.

input-otp.description: Collect a short verification code in visually separated slots.
input-otp.guidance: Set maxLength to the expected code length. Slot indexes start at zero and must remain within that length.

item.description: Lay out a compact row of content with optional media and actions.
item.guidance: Use ItemContent for the main text and ItemActions for controls. A group of items can share separators for a denser layout.

kbd.description: Display a key or keyboard shortcut within explanatory text.
kbd.guidance: Kbd is a visual label and does not register a shortcut. Implement the actual keyboard behavior in your application.

label.description: Associate a clear text label with a form control.
label.guidance: Match htmlFor with the input id. Keep the visible label available instead of relying on placeholder text alone.

marker.description: Mark a boundary or moment in a feed or conversation.
marker.guidance: Choose a separator variant to divide groups visually. Keep its text concise, such as a date or status change.

menubar.description: Expose groups of commands in a desktop-style menu bar.
menubar.guidance: Each menu has its own trigger and content. Use command names that make sense outside their visual grouping.

message.description: Structure a conversation entry with an author, content, and metadata.
message.guidance: Use MessageHeader and MessageFooter for attribution and time. Pair MessageContent with Bubble when you want a chat-bubble appearance.

message-scroller.description: Keep a conversation scrollable as messages are added.
message-scroller.guidance: Wrap the scroller in MessageScrollerProvider and give its parent a fixed height. Assign each item a stable messageId.

native-select.description: Use the browser’s built-in select control with consistent styling.
native-select.guidance: Provide a label and a meaningful option value. Prefer it when native platform behavior is more important than a custom popup.

navigation-menu.description: Organize primary navigation links and optional content panels.
navigation-menu.guidance: Use links for destinations and triggers for expandable groups. Keep navigation labels concise and descriptive.

pagination.description: Move between pages of a larger collection.
pagination.guidance: Track the current page and mark its link active. Connect previous and next actions to your data source or route.

popover.description: Show contextual content in an anchored floating panel.
popover.guidance: Give the panel a title or accessible label. Use controlled open state when opening or closing depends on application events.

progress.description: Represent the completion of a measurable task.
progress.guidance: Provide a numeric value and an accessible label. Add text when the exact percentage matters to the user.

questionnaire.description: Guide a user through a structured set of questions.
questionnaire.guidance: Declare stable item names and choice values. Handle submission in your application and keep required questions clearly identified.

radio-group.description: Choose one option from a set of mutually exclusive values.
radio-group.guidance: Give the group a clear label and each item a visible option name. Use defaultValue or controlled value to establish the selection.

resizable.description: Let users adjust the space allocated to neighboring panels.
resizable.guidance: Place handles between panels in a panel group. Give the container a useful size and set minimum panel sizes when content requires them.

scroll-area.description: Contain overflowing content within a styled scroll region.
scroll-area.guidance: Set a bounded height or width to enable scrolling. Keep the content readable and avoid nesting unnecessary scroll regions.

select.description: Choose one value from a custom popup list.
select.guidance: Compose a trigger, current value, and option list. Label the trigger and use stable values for the options.

separator.description: Separate groups of related content visually.
separator.guidance: Choose horizontal or vertical orientation to match the layout. Avoid adding separators between elements that already read as one group.

sheet.description: Open a supporting panel from the side of the screen.
sheet.guidance: Include a title and description and provide a way to close it. Use a dialog for a centered task that should dominate the page.

sidebar.description: Build persistent navigation with a responsive mobile panel.
sidebar.guidance: Wrap the layout in SidebarProvider. Use SidebarInset for the main content and SidebarTrigger when the navigation can collapse.

skeleton.description: Reserve space while content is loading.
skeleton.guidance: Match the approximate dimensions of the content that will replace it. Announce loading through surrounding accessible text when needed.

slider.description: Adjust a numeric value by dragging or using the keyboard.
slider.guidance: Specify the minimum, maximum, and step for your range. Controlled values are arrays so the same component can represent multiple thumbs.

sonner.description: Show temporary notifications through the Sonner toast system.
sonner.guidance: Mount one Toaster for the relevant application area. Trigger messages through the sonner toast API and use next-themes for theme synchronization.

spinner.description: Indicate that an operation is still running.
spinner.guidance: Pair it with short status text when the reason for waiting is not obvious. Avoid hiding an actionable error behind indefinite loading.

switch.description: Turn a setting on or off immediately.
switch.guidance: Use a label that describes the setting itself. Prefer a checkbox when the choice is part of a form that needs explicit submission.

table.description: Display structured rows and columns with semantic HTML.
table.guidance: Give columns meaningful headings and add a caption for context. Use Data Table when you need a typed data-driven composition.

tabs.description: Switch between related panels within the same page.
tabs.guidance: Match each trigger value with a content value. Use tabs for peer content rather than a sequence of steps.

textarea.description: Collect longer text that may span several lines.
textarea.guidance: Supply a visible label and choose a useful starting size. Keep validation and character limits close to the field.

toast.description: Display transient notifications with the Base UI toast manager.
toast.guidance: Mount Toaster and call toast.add to create a notification. Keep important information available elsewhere after the toast disappears.

toggle.description: Represent a button that can remain pressed.
toggle.guidance: Give the toggle an accessible name describing the option. Use pressed and onPressedChange when controlling its state.

toggle-group.description: Collect related pressed-state choices into a single group.
toggle-group.guidance: Give every item a distinct value and label. Choose whether one or multiple options may be active for your use case.

tooltip.description: Explain a control with short text on hover or focus.
tooltip.guidance: Wrap tooltip content in TooltipProvider. Use tooltips for supplementary information rather than the only label of a control.

typography.description: Build a consistent hierarchy using semantic text components.
typography.guidance: Choose the heading level for document structure, not just appearance. Combine the exported paragraph and supporting-text styles as needed.
